alerts.title: An Incident Train Switching Back From Eastbound Church to Westbound Castro
alerts.description: SF Muni reports an incident train will switch back from eastbound Church to westbound Castro and exit the subway out of service. Slow-moving westbound service possible between Castro and West Portal.
